items.item_text: Serve Safe Certification or equivalent or superior certification or to be obtained within 6 months of employment.
CCC certification with the American Culinary Federation or equivalent. (Preferred)
Bachelor's degree in a related area.
5 years of related experience or 9 years equivalent related experience if no degree.

5 years of culinary management experience, preferably in a college or university environment with independent decision making for menu planning, customer service, staffing and financial management. (Preferred)
Experience sufficient to effectively utilize online scheduling and time and attendance software.
Demonstrated culinary experience sufficient to direct the total culinary operation of multiple retain and residential food facilities that range in size and complexity from small to large.
Demonstrated experience in managing and completing staffing tables and scheduling procedures.

Demonstrated experience and skill in specifying, ordering, receiving, storing, securing and distributing food, supplies and equipment generally associated with large, complex retail and residential operations.
Demonstrated experience and skill in managing multiple inventories and ability to audit and identify potential programs and solutions.
Demonstrated experience in forecasting of inventory, production, ordering, menu management, inventory management, access control, point-of-sale systems.
Demonstrated experience in developing cycle menus with input from staff, student groups, surveys, industry trends and related data.

Demonstrated experience in producing diverse, cost effective and current trend menus for food programs in catering, retail, and residential operations using the highest quality foods at the lowest possible price.
Demonstrated experience in developing specialized catering menus and customized menus based on customer request.
Demonstrated experience in accurately writing recipes, records, reports and letters.
Oversees Dining Services Operations:

Continually assess and improve processes and procedures. Plans and develops service operations while ensuring compliance with food handling, preparation, and service standards for quality assurance, safety, and security.
Food Production and Service Delivery Oversight:
Oversees and supervises food production and service delivery. Maintains a high-quality food production system. Develops and implements exceptional food production and customer service standards.

Direct involvement in staff training programs. Creates and provides continuous training to all food production staff, supervisors, and managers in food preparation, presentation, customer service, sanitation, and safety. Develops and implements standards for food production and service delivery, including sanitation standards to meet all health codes.
Leads Menu Planning and Recipe Development:
Leads menu development, creates menus for food service operations, and develops recipes for production testing and culinary evaluation.

Supervises staff and provides excellent communication and interpersonal skills when interacting with supervisors and management. Ensures that all staff meet quality assurance standards. Oversees, mentors, and develops staff, setting team goals and performance standards. Provides guidance on complex and sensitive issues, assigns work, and monitors team progress. Manages staffing needs, including recruitment, hiring, performance evaluations, and professional development to ensure operational efficiency. Recommends actions related to compensation, promotions, reclassifications, discipline, and grievance resolutions.

Manages budgetary responsibility within cost per meal and general cost guidelines. Oversees food procurement, receiving, and inventory control. Develops quality control programs to ensure optimal product quality.
Sustainability Program Management:

In collaboration with the management team, the Executive Chef plays a vital role in sustainability programs. These programs focus on areas such as recycling, utilizing organic and fresh, locally grown foods, water conservation, responsible purchasing, waste awareness, food recovery, nutrition management, and fostering student and community involvement through educational events. The Executive Chef may also serve on departmental, campus, and UC-wide sustainability committees.
Supervision and Facility Management:
Monitors maintenance and repair needs in all kitchen and production areas to ensure that managers, supervisors, and sous chefs provide adequate levels of functionality, safety, and sanitation.
Proven culinary and management performance in high volume food services accounts.
Background check required.
Advanced knowledge in food preparation, nutrition, special needs and sanitation regulations.
Advanced verbal and written communication in the English language, and active listening, dynamic flexibility, critical thinking, and ability to multi-task and ensure effective time management.
Advanced decision making and reasoning skills, and ability to develop original ideas to solve problems, and perform operations analysis and quality control analysis.
Intermediate computer application skills.
Advanced skill in effective interpersonal and work leadership skills to provide guidance to all levels of personnel.
Demonstrated ability to maintain the accuracy of recipe files in an automated menu management system.
Ability to communicate ideas and direction clearly and effectively verbally and in writing.
Organizational skills sufficient to direct and organize the culinary training of supervisors, students, and staff.
Ability to be proactive, foresee any potential problems and act quickly to remedy them.
Skill sufficient to provide ongoing training in support of delivering excellence in customer service.
Ability to maintain and promote positive customer and employee relations.
Ability to recognize and appropriately deal with sensitive or confidential information and situations.
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality in personnel and departmental matters.
Skill to effectively and cooperatively work with a diverse group in a team setting.
Ability to conduct business in a professional manner that is respectful, diplomatic and positive.
Ability to effectively conduct focus groups and preview tasting of any and all new menu items to gain feedback.
